summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repo. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and Tuple[ControlType, str] to the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the title sequence format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, returning True only when is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title with the second tuple item; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Not run: tests and Black were not executed per instructions; I checked by reading that added Python lines stay within 88 columns. Nothing committed.
